subject: Evaluation dataset exchange & MAP — NimbleFin pilot
messages:
From: Alex Brown <alex.brown@nimblefin.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: tara.patel@nimblefin.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation dataset exchange & MAP — NimbleFin pilot

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with Redwood's ability to hold latency under 120ms on our typical 1k token scenarios. We'd like to move to a short pilot to validate quality and integration effort.

High-level ask: exchange a limited assessment dataset and a small prompt pack so our SRE and ML teams can run the same acceptance tests you use for MAP sign-off. Key constraints from our side:
- Data must be ephemeral (30-day sandbox), stored only in the sandbox environment; no production copies.
- Usage limited to the pilot project and Redwood engineers for debugging.
- We need an explicit retention and destruction schedule.

Can you propose a mutual action plan (MAP) and a timeline for dataset delivery, acceptance gates, and closing? Also please confirm what form of legal/NDAs you need — our procurement prefers a short MSA + SOW or an evaluation addendum.

Attaching a short deck on the pilot goals.

Regards,
Alex Brown
Head of ML Ops
NimbleFin

Attachment: nimblefin_pilot_goals.pdf (pdf, 430KB)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Alex Brown <alex.brown@nimblefin.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation dataset exchange & MAP — NimbleFin pilot

Alex — great to hear and thanks for the clear constraints. Draft MAP attached; high-level proposal below and proposed timeline.

Summary proposal (high level)
- Sandbox access: ephemeral project sandbox in us-west with isolated keyspace and logging turned on; 30-day data retention by default.
- Dataset scope: up to 10k assessment examples, anonymized. We will accept your testcases.zip (we'll scan & ingest).
- Usage constraints: access limited to NimbleFin pilot group + named Redwood debug accounts; no external sharing.
- Acceptance gates: data ingested -> smoke tests (3 business days) -> quality eval (7 business days) -> production readiness recommendation.
- Destruction: automated purge after 30 days from first ingest; manual early purge available on request with audit trail.

Timeline (proposed)
- Day 0: MAP execution (evaluation addendum signed) + data drop.
- Day 1-3: ingestion + smoke tests.
- Day 4-10: quality run + evaluation report + joint review.
- Day 11-14: optional small tuning iteration.

Attached: NimbleFin_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (contains the evaluation addendum language and access controls).

Questions for your team:
1) Do you need us to host the dataset in a private VPC for the pilot or is our isolated sandbox sufficient?
2) Who will be the named NimbleFin pilot users (email list) for ACLs?
3) Any additional legal requirements beyond a short addendum? Procurement contact would be helpful.

I'll loop Naomi for security/compliance sign-off once we have the initial scope. If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute sync tomorrow to finalize the MAP.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: NimbleFin_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: Tara Patel <tara.patel@nimblefin.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Brown <alex.brown@nimblefin.com>, procurement@nimblefin.com
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation dataset exchange & MAP — NimbleFin pilot

Jasmine,

Thanks — this is helpful. A few quick redlines/clarifications from our legal & security teams (see attached redline doc):
- Add explicit data handling language that the dataset will not be used to train models outside of the pilot (we need an AI training restriction).
- Clarify that audit logs for accesses are available to NimbleFin on request (summary export).
- Confirm that the deletion operation is irreversible and that Redwood will provide a deletion certificate.

We are okay with the sandbox (no VPC required) for the pilot, but we'll need the named ACLs: tara.patel@nimblefin.com, alex.brown@nimblefin.com, and two engineers — linda.hsu@nimblefin.com and rafael.gomez@nimblefin.com.

Attached is our test suite for the pilot (nimblefin_testcases_v2.zip) and a redlined MAP doc (redlines_nimblefin_MAP.docx). Small ask on timeline: procurement wants the evaluation addendum signed within 5 business days to keep internal approvals moving.

On the training restriction clause — we can accept a scoped, time-limited non-training use covenant in the addendum; would you be able to add that?

Thanks,
Tara
Director of Platform Engineering
NimbleFin

Attachments: nimblefin_testcases_v2.zip (zip, 2.1MB); redlines_nimblefin_MAP.docx (docx, 45KB)

Subject: Re: Evaluation dataset exchange & MAP — NimbleFin pilot (next steps & docusign)

Tara / Alex — thanks for the redlines and the testcases. We reviewed the doc and have the following updates:

1) Training restriction: added a 45-day non-training covenant for the dataset tied to the pilot period; language included in the attached docx.
2) Deletion certificate & audit logs: we will provide an audit export and a signed deletion certificate after purge.
3) ACLs: added the four NimbleFin pilot accounts you listed.
4) Timeline: we can meet procurement's 5-business-day window if we receive signed addendum by EOD next Tue (2027-06-01).

Next steps (proposed)
- I will upload the revised addendum to DocuSign tonight (link below). Please have Procurement sign by 2027-06-01 to keep the timeline.
- Once signed, drop the testcases to our secure ingest (secure-upload link included in DocuSign envelope).
- We'll begin ingestion and smoke tests within 24 hours of receipt.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/NF-PILOT-42
Drive: https://drive.redwood/company/nimblefin/map-draft-v1

If you want a quick alignment call to walk procurement through the non-training covenant language, Karthik and I are available tomorrow at 10:30am PT.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
